ENV.description: Firecrawl runtime mode. Keep local for this self-hosted deployment.

SUPER_ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Super admin username for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Generated super admin password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

APISERVER_JWT_SECRET_KEY.description: Generated apiserver jwt secret key. Keep private and preserve with backups.

APISERVER_DB_NAME.description: Apiserver db name for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

GATEWAY_DB_NAME.description: Gateway db name for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

VITE_API_BASE_URL.description: Vite api base url for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

VITE_WS_BASE_URL.description: Vite ws base url for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

VITE_MCP_GATEWAY_BASE_URL.description: Vite mcp gateway base url for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

VITE_GATEWAY_SERVICE_BASE_URL.description: Vite gateway service base url resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

VITE_DIRECT_MCP_GATEWAY_MODIFIER.description: Vite direct mcp gateway modifier for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OAUTH2_ISSUER.description: Oauth2 issuer resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

LOGGER_LEVEL.description: Logger level for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

LLM_CONFIG_ADMIN_ONLY.description: Llm config admin only for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.

UPSTREAM_HOST.description: Upstream host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

UPSTREAM_PORT.description: Upstream port for unla. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OWNER_AUTH.description: Owner auth for unla. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: Generated access password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.
